title: Legal Administrator
description:
Legal Administrator/Legal Assistant

Alconbury

£28,000 - £30,000

Full-time Permanent

The Role

We are working with a firm looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Legal Administrator / Legal Assistant to provide dedicated support to one of the firm's Construction Specialists.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build their experience within a well-regarded law firm, supporting a specialist legal team with a range of administrative and legal support duties.

Previous experience within construction law is not essential, and candidates from other legal practice areas or wider legal support backgrounds will be considered. The most important qualities are excellent attention to detail, reliability and a methodical approach to work.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing day-to-day administrative and legal support to a Construction Solicitor.
- Assisting with the preparation, formatting and organisation of legal documents and correspondence.
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper filing systems.
- Managing and updating client and matter records.
- Assisting with the preparation and administration of construction-related legal documentation.
- Reviewing documents and information to ensure accuracy and completeness.
- Uploading, saving and organising documentation within the firm's case management system.
- Assisting with document management and ensuring files are kept up to date.
- Handling incoming telephone calls, emails and general client enquiries where required.
- Liaising with fee earners, clients and other internal departments.
- Providing general administrative assistance to ensure the smooth running of the Construction team.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced within a legal environment, ideally in a Legal Administrator, Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or similar position.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to completing tasks.
- Thorough and accurate when handling documentation, records and administrative processes.
- Comfortable undertaking repetitive, process-driven work while maintaining high standards.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and able to pick up new systems quickly.
- Able to manage their workload effectively and meet deadlines.
- A strong communicator with a professional and approachable manner.
- Reliable, conscientious and comfortable working independently as well as part of a wider team.
- Interested in developing their career within legal administration and support.

Previous construction law experience is not essential, and candidates with experience in other legal practice areas will be welcomed.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to join an established and highly regarded top 150 law firm.
- A dedicated support position within the firm's Construction team.
- Exposure to specialist construction-related legal work.
- The opportunity to develop your knowledge of legal administration within a specialist practice area.
- A supportive working environment alongside experienced legal professionals.
- The chance to build a long-term career within legal support.

Why Apply?

This is a great opportunity for an existing Legal Administrator, Legal Assistant or Legal Secretary looking for their next move within a reputable law firm.

You don't need to have worked in construction previously. If you have a legal background, enjoy organised and detail-focused work, and take pride in getting the small things right, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Legal PA
description:
Owen Reed is looking for a proactive and organised Legal PA to join the Private department of a law firm in Cambridge.

Working as part of the Legal Operations team, you will provide timely, high-quality administrative and coordination support to a group of lawyers. This varied role includes client contact, matter management, billing, diary management and travel coordination, working within a friendly and high-performing team.

The successful candidate will be self-motivated and reliable, with the ability to manage their workload, plan ahead and adapt to changing priorities while consistently delivering accurate work to deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

Matter Management
- Support fee earners and Senior Legal PAs throughout the client and matter lifecycle, following documented procedures.
- Work closely with client onboarding and compliance specialists to ensure all required information and documentation is obtained, issued and correctly stored.
- Support compliance with policies covering new matters, retainer letters, conflict checks, searches, Client Due Diligence and Know Your Client requirements.
- Maintain electronic and hard-copy documents in accordance with the firm's filing protocols.
- Ensure inactive matters are closed, client funds are returned and files are archived promptly.

Financial Management & Billing
- Develop a strong understanding of billing processes and systems to support the preparation of accurate bills and financial information.
- Ensure matters are set up with the correct rates, discounts and billing details, and that Money on Account is collected or files are recorded on the exempt list.
- Help monitor and address unpaid bills, liaising with Credit Control where required.
- Support the accurate and timely processing of disbursement invoices and payments.

Fee Earner Support
- Act as a first point of contact for assigned fee earners, handling calls, emails, correspondence and meeting requests, responding on their behalf where appropriate.
- Manage calendars across multiple time zones, scheduling calls and meetings and following up as needed.
- Assist with expense claims and other business-related requirements.

Travel Coordination
- Manage travel arrangements through the firm's in-house travel provider.
- Prepare itineraries and ensure business expenses are captured, approved and processed in accordance with policy.

Business Development
- Organise business breakfasts, lunches and dinners, including associated expenses.
- Record referrals and contacts in InterAction and maintain CRM lists.

Delegation & Coordination
- Work with Business Administrators to coordinate filing, archiving, scanning, photocopying, contact updates and courier arrangements.
- Delegate document formatting, production, typing, amendments, house styling and proofreading to the Document Production Unit as appropriate.
- Liaise with Legal Support Services, the Global Capability Centre and other departments to obtain specialist input or delegate tasks, retaining ownership and following up where required.

Team Support & Collaboration
- Contribute to a cohesive working environment and provide cover for Senior Legal PAs and other Legal Operations colleagues.
- Work flexibly across Legal Operations teams to meet business needs.
- Take responsibility for your workload, communicate working arrangements clearly and follow through on commitments.
- Demonstrate the firm's core values and support its Equity, Diversity and Inclusion strategy.
- Develop a focus area or specialism to build skills and contribute to service improvement, innovation and engagement across Legal Support Services.

Skills & Experience
- Previous administrative experience supporting a team within a similar professional services environment, ideally legal.
- Strong time management skills, with the ability to balance multiple tasks, plan ahead and respond positively to changing requirements.
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills and a willingness to learn new systems.
- Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure.
- An organised, methodical approach and confidence working within structured processes and compliance frameworks.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with different people and working styles.
- A collaborative approach, with the flexibility to support additional fee earners and wider team requirements.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including drafting professional business correspondence.
- Discretion and sound judgement when handling sensitive or confidential information.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
